data.title: RB Leipzig vs Manchester City prediction, preview & betting tips – 04/11/2026
data.content:
Antoine Semenyo continues to miss out for Man City, and other players need to step up after a turn of form.

The Cityzens are now winless in three games in normal time in all competitions (D1, L2), having beaten Brighton on penalties in the Carabao Cup.

The Seagulls got their revenge over Enzo Maresca's men though, and so they have fallen behind Arsenal in the Premier League table. [...] Their away form has let them down, but on home soil, they have been perfect.

Red Bulls manager Martin Demichelis is also a familiar name to Man City having played for them, and it is safe to say he has had a decent start after replacing Bournemouth-bound Marco Rose.

The Argentine may be without Maxime Esteve, who missed Leipzig's win at Schalke, but the hosts have no other concerns in their squad. [...] Manchester City are aiming to bounce back from successive Premier League defeats when they travel to Germany to face RB Leipzig in the Champions League on Wednesday night.

The Cityzens lost 1-0 at home to Brighton & Hove Albion last weekend, after also going down 2-1 at Aston Villa.

Meanwhile, Leipzig beat Schalke 2-0 away from home in the Bundesliga and have won their last three games in all competitions.
